menu.subtitle: Endless rope ninja
menu.title: Ninja Grip
menu.hint: Aim and shoot your rope at hanging targets. Stand on platforms or hang from handles to aim carefully. Don't fall behind!

help.subtitle: Ninja guide
help.title: How to play?
help.aimBody: Use the aim stick (or mouse) to point at a hanging target.
help.fireBody: Shoot a straight rope projectile. It only attaches to targets.
help.swingBody: While attached, swing with move keys and shorten/lengthen the rope.
help.restBody: Stand on platforms or hang from handles to aim safely. Targets break if you hang too long.
help.scrollBody: The camera stays still until you pass mid-screen. After that it drifts right — red edges warn you; leave the frame and it's game over.

battle.loseMsg: Try again — earn coins in the main run.

hideSeek.subtitle: Find them all before time runs out
hideSeek.title: Ninja Hide & Seek
hideSeek.instructions:
You are the seeker — find 9 hiding ninjas.
D-pad to move • 🔫 to shoot
Hit a ninja = found!
You have 60 seconds and 12 bullets.
